categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/torcontrol.cpp and src/torcontrol.h, which implement Bitcoin Core's Tor integration.
categories.rationale: Reduces debug log spam caused by default Tor control connection attempts. Since v32, unconfigured nodes without Tor logged around 18 lines of warnings and info lines per hour; silencing these behind debug categories cleans up logs for standard node operators without impacting network functionality.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Category explicitly excludes logging changes whose point is one specific area's behavior.
categories.rationale: Excluded by definition: the logging adjustments in torcontrol.cpp and init.cpp pertain strictly to Tor integration rather than shared logging infrastructure.
